data: You whip up a maelstrom of harsh winds. Each creature in a 30 ft radius, centered on a point within range, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and knocked prone on a failure, or half as much damage without being knocked prone on a success. Targets that fail the saving throw by 5 or more become confused. If this attack is activated during rain, the targets roll their saving throws with disadvantage. If used during harsh sunlight, the targets roll their saves with advantage.
Badly startles all Pokémon that successfully showed their appeal.
All Pokemon that succeeded the Judge DC and gained appeal points must make CHA Saving Throws against Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
